title: Turbo Tackle - Free browser football game. First game solo developed. Would love feedback! https://turbotackle.app/
author: Ordinary-Tutor-5556
selftext:
[https://turbotackle.app/](https://turbotackle.app/)

  
Turbo Tackle is a free football game that runs in your browser, with no download or signup. You run the offense: call a play from a fresh sheet of options, snap the ball, then throw to a receiver, run, juke, spin and sprint while the CPU defense reads and adapts to the plays you keep calling. Play a quick game against any city team, or start a My Team career. Pick a city, play a full season and the playoffs, then manage the offseason: re-sign or release players, draft rookies, sign free agents, trade, and spend coaching credits on training. Seven difficulty levels let beginners and experts both find a challenge. It plays well on a laptop with the keyboard or mouse, and on a phone with touch controls. All teams use city names only, and every player is fictional but comparable to real players. My Career mode coming soon! Would love feedback on anything!
